questions.question: Distinguish between normative ethics and applied ethics.
questions.solution_html:
• Normative ethics deals with general moral standards or what ought to be
  • done.It is theoretical
  • Applied ethics deals with specific issues. It is practical
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026
questions.final_answer: Applied ethics deals with specific issues. It is practical
